title: Vietnam is looking to restrict social media for kids; here are the growing number of other countries doing the same
summary: Australia was the first country to issue a ban in late 2025, aiming to reduce the pressures and risks that young users may face on social media, including cyberbullying, social media addiction, and exposure to predators.
llm_summary: Several countries are restricting social media usage for kids due to growing concerns about online safety and well-being. Australia was the first to issue a ban in 2025, aiming to mitigate issues like cyberbullying, addiction, and exposure to predators. Other countries may follow suit, indicating a shift towards prioritizing children's online protection.
